```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

source("R/model.R", local = TRUE)

station_labels <- c(
  body_shop      = "Body shop",
  paint          = "Paint",
  final_assembly = "Final assembly",
  inspection     = "Inspection"
)
```

## Overview

This interactive document runs a **discrete-event simulation** of a serial
automotive manufacturing line in R using [simmer](https://r-simmer.org/).
Vehicles arrive and flow through four stations:

**Body shop → Paint → Final assembly → Inspection**

Adjust the parameters below and click **Run simulation** to refresh the KPIs
and plots. All defaults are **placeholder example values** for portfolio demos —
not real plant data.

## Parameters

```{r}
#| label: inputs
#| echo: false

fluidRow(
  column(
    4,
    h4("Arrivals & run"),
    numericInput("arrival_mean", "Mean interarrival (min)",
                 value = 4, min = 0.5, max = 60, step = 0.5),
    numericInput("sim_length", "Sim length (min)",
                 value = 480, min = 60, max = 4800, step = 30),
    numericInput("warmup", "Warmup (min)",
                 value = 60, min = 0, max = 2400, step = 15),
    numericInput("n_reps", "Replications",
                 value = 5, min = 1, max = 20, step = 1),
    numericInput("seed", "Base seed",
                 value = 20261027, min = 1, step = 1)
  ),
  column(
    4,
    h4("Body shop & paint"),
    numericInput("body_cap", "Body shop capacity", value = 2, min = 1, max = 20),
    numericInput("body_mean", "Body shop mean (min)", value = 6, min = 0.5, max = 60, step = 0.5),
    numericInput("paint_cap", "Paint capacity", value = 1, min = 1, max = 20),
    numericInput("paint_mean", "Paint mean (min)", value = 8, min = 0.5, max = 60, step = 0.5)
  ),
  column(
    4,
    h4("Assembly & inspection"),
    numericInput("fa_cap", "Final assembly capacity", value = 2, min = 1, max = 20),
    numericInput("fa_mean", "Final assembly mean (min)", value = 7, min = 0.5, max = 60, step = 0.5),
    numericInput("insp_cap", "Inspection capacity", value = 1, min = 1, max = 20),
    numericInput("insp_mean", "Inspection mean (min)", value = 3, min = 0.5, max = 60, step = 0.5),
    br(),
    actionButton("run", "Run simulation", class = "btn-primary")
  )
)
```

## About this model

This portfolio foundation uses:

- **simmer** for the DES engine
- **tidyverse** for tidy results and ggplot2 visuals
- **Shiny** (via `server: shiny` in Quarto) for interactivity

Each replication sets its own seed (`base_seed + rep - 1`) so results are
reproducible. Warmup observations are discarded before computing throughput,
cycle time, WIP, utilization, and queues.

**Caveat:** defaults are placeholders chosen to show a clear paint-booth
bottleneck. Replace them with real line data before any decision use.

```{r}
#| context: server

build_params <- reactive({
  list(
    sim_length_min   = input$sim_length,
    n_replications   = as.integer(input$n_reps),
    base_seed        = as.integer(input$seed),
    warmup_min       = input$warmup,
    arrival_mean_min = input$arrival_mean,
    stations = tribble(
      ~name,              ~capacity,                   ~dist,         ~mean_min,        ~sd_min,
      "body_shop",        as.integer(input$body_cap),  "exponential", input$body_mean,  NA_real_,
      "paint",            as.integer(input$paint_cap), "normal",      input$paint_mean, 1.5,
      "final_assembly",   as.integer(input$fa_cap),    "normal",      input$fa_mean,    1.0,
      "inspection",       as.integer(input$insp_cap),  "exponential", input$insp_mean,  NA_real_
    )
  )
})

sim_result <- reactive({
  run_line_sim(build_params())
}) %>% bindEvent(input$run, ignoreNULL = FALSE)

output$kpi_boxes <- renderUI({
  res <- sim_result()
  lab <- station_labels[[res$bottleneck]]
  if (is.null(lab)) lab <- res$bottleneck
  layout_columns(
    value_box(
      title = "Throughput",
      value = sprintf("%.1f veh/hr", res$headline$throughput_per_hr_mean),
      theme = "primary"
    ),
    value_box(
      title = "Mean cycle time",
      value = sprintf("%.0f min", res$headline$cycle_time_mean_mean),
      theme = "info"
    ),
    value_box(
      title = "Avg WIP",
      value = sprintf("%.1f veh", res$headline$avg_wip_mean),
      theme = "warning"
    ),
    value_box(
      title = "Bottleneck",
      value = lab,
      theme = "danger"
    )
  )
})

output$plot_util <- renderPlot({
  res <- sim_result()
  res$station_headline %>%
    mutate(
      resource = factor(resource, levels = names(station_labels)),
      label = station_labels[as.character(resource)]
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = label, y = avg_util_mean)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2c7fb8", width = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = pmax(0, avg_util_mean - avg_util_sd),
          ymax = pmin(1, avg_util_mean + avg_util_sd)),
      width = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Utilization",
         title = "Station utilization (mean ± SD)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))
})

output$plot_queue <- renderPlot({
  res <- sim_result()
  res$resources_ts %>%
    mutate(
      resource = factor(resource, levels = names(station_labels)),
      label = station_labels[as.character(resource)]
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = time, y = queue, color = label)) +
    geom_step(linewidth = 0.7) +
    labs(x = "Time (minutes)", y = "Queue length", color = "Station",
         title = "Queue length over time (replication 1)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
})

output$plot_cycle <- renderPlot({
  res <- sim_result()
  req(nrow(res$cycles) > 0)
  mean_ct <- mean(res$cycles$cycle_time, na.rm = TRUE)
  res$cycles %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = cycle_time)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#41b6c4", color = "white") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean_ct, linetype = "dashed", color = "#253494") +
    labs(x = "Cycle time (minutes)", y = "Count",
         title = "Vehicle cycle time distribution",
         subtitle = paste0("Mean = ", round(mean_ct, 1), " min")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
})

output$table_metrics <- renderDT({
  res <- sim_result()
  tbl <- res$station_headline %>%
    mutate(
      Station = station_labels[resource],
      `Util %` = round(100 * avg_util_mean, 1),
      `Util SD` = round(100 * avg_util_sd, 1),
      `Avg queue` = round(avg_queue_mean, 2),
      `Queue SD` = round(avg_queue_sd, 2)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Station, `Util %`, `Util SD`, `Avg queue`, `Queue SD`)
  datatable(tbl, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", ordering = FALSE))
})
```
